exposure: timing of disease onset (antepartum vs. intrapartum)
severity of disease (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, preeclampsia with severe features)
outcome: need for outpatient antihypertensive medications at time of hospital discharge
cohort: The study included 204 patients diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP), excluding those with chronic hypertension.
finding: Timing of onset of HDP (antepartum vs. intrapartum) was not an independent risk factor for needing postpartum antihypertensive medications, but proteinuria and the presence of severe features were.
